# BitWave — agent index

BitWave: a bit register rendered as a wavetable. Three lanes of `A op B -> Z`,
CSV/TSV input, stepped LFO, single offline HTML file.

- Canonical app: `bitwave-v2.html` (open directly; no server, no network).
- Contract: `docs/AGENT-INTERFACE.md` (tools, envelope, deeplink, bridge, CLI, MCP).
- Onboarding: `AGENTS.md`; manifest: `agent/manifest.json`; examples: `agent/examples/`.
- Browser bridge: `window.bitwave`; hidden state: `#bitwave-state`;
  ready: `body[data-agent-ready='true']`; events: `bitwave:ready`, `bitwave:change`.
- Toolset 1.1.0; `.bitwave` schema 3 (schema 1/2 load). Bridge additions:
  `setExpression(frame, text)`, `record(on)`, `getLog({limit})`; state additions:
  `recording:{on,rows}`, `lanes[*].expressions`.
- Expression sources are deterministic in the shared core: routes -> expressions -> Z;
  each expression sees the current frames plus the previous recorded row as `log.<frame>`.
  Record is a transient in-memory DAW take (not saved in `.bitwave`/links); float is a
  legitimate authoring format converted once at the boundary to exact values.
- CLI: `node agent/cli.mjs help`; MCP: `node agent/mcp-server.mjs` (stdio, zero deps).
- Tools: `manifest`, `analyze_register`, `evaluate_lane`, `compare_operands`,
  `parse_dataset`, `build_deeplink`.
- Machine setup: Node >= 23.6; no browser needed for CLI/MCP.
